name: Biological Sciences PhD
detailsNote: Fall 2027 deadline confirmed; admission model is not stated on the checked pages.

english.note: Also accepts PTE Academic 68 and Cambridge 185. Exemptions are case by case; request within the application. Qualifying routes include native English/country criteria, two years of recent study in specified English-language countries, or a degree from India.

documents: Statement of intent: four answers, maximum 300 words each

applicationFee.note: 2026–2027 published fee. International and domestic financial-hardship requests considered case by case; upload explanation and supporting documents through the application process. Not guaranteed. Submit application without paying, then complete the status-page waiver form with documentation by the program deadline; prior fees are not refunded.

requirements.note: US four-year bachelor's degree or international equivalent required. Transcripts need English or certified translation; final official records required on acceptance. GRE subject test recommended, not required.
